summary: Full backend + frontend coverage of the 4 NEW features (auto-call on create, reset lead, replay after reset, printable Report card) + waveform + regression. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with TestAutoCallOnCreate (3), TestResetLead (4) — 34/34 pytest passing serially (see note on parallel flake). Frontend (real REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, demo-login-btn): T1 Auto-call — checkbox default CHECKED, submit label 'Add & AI Call', ZTest Auto Alpha (30 days) came back as APPOINTMENT/91 in the row and the profile showed AI Lead Summary + Site Visit + Follow-up. T2 Report — /report/leads/:id renders report-sheet with LEADPILOT header, AI Lead Score, 'Why this lead is HOT' breakdown, AI Lead Summary, Qualified Information, Latest AI Call, Appointment and Recommended Next Steps; print-report-btn and report-back both work. T3 Reset (non-star ZTest lead) — profile flips to NEW/15, no APPOINTMENT/Site Visit remain. T4 Auto-call OFF — submit label switches to 'Add Lead' and the ZTest NoAuto Beta lead persists as NEW/15 with no call. T5 Rahul killer flow — waveform (call-waveform) visible during connecting/talking and hidden on the result panel; call-finish-btn produces 91/HOT/APPOINTMENT; Reset returns Rahul to CONTACTED/42 (calls/appointments/followups cleared); Replay Start AI Call again gives 91/HOT with exactly one Site Visit appointment and one follow-up (no duplicates). No console errors during the flows.

minor.issue: Flaky when tests run in parallel (-n 2 default): TestAICallIdempotency intermittently gets a 404 on the freshly-created TEST_Idem lead. All 34 tests pass serially (-n 0). Likely a race between the two ai-call workers hitting shared LLM/mongo state, not a functional bug.
No DELETE endpoint exists — the frontend has no delete UI either. Cleanup has to go straight to Mongo. Consider adding for QA/demo hygiene.
Still no organization_id scoping — pre-existing IDOR risk carried forward from iterations 1 & 2.

issues: Prompt still occasionally weaves the lead name into property context (carried from iteration 2). Cosmetic.

action_items: Investigate parallel flake in TestAICallIdempotency (safe to keep -n 2 for now — retry or pin that class to a single worker). Not blocking.
Optional: add a DELETE /api/leads/{id} endpoint so tests / demo cleanup don't have to poke Mongo directly.
Pre-existing: scope /appointments, /calls, /activities and /leads/{id} to caller's organization_id.
critical_code_review_comments: run_ai_qualification is a clean shared helper reused by both POST /api/leads (auto_call=true) and POST /api/leads/{id}/ai-call — no duplication, and the idempotent delete_many-before-insert for Site Visit / Scheduled follow-up is preserved.
reset_lead correctly wipes calls/appointments/followups/activities and reverts fields (CONTACTED/42 for star, NEW/15 otherwise) — confirmed via API and UI.
Waveform component is purely presentational, correctly hidden on phase==='done' so it disappears on the result panel.
ReportCard fetches from /api/leads/:id and gracefully handles missing call/appointment/follow-up.
server.py is now >800 lines and mixes seed/scoring/LLM/routes — worth splitting (carried over).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 4 new features + regression (auto-call on/off, report card, reset star & non-star, replay no-duplicates, waveform show/hide, Rahul killer flow)

seed_data_creation: Created 'ZTest Auto Alpha' and 'ZTest NoAuto Beta' via the UI; deleted both directly from Mongo after tests. TEST_ leads created by pytest are cleaned by the session-scoped autouse fixture. Rahul Sharma reset to CONTACTED/42 at end via reset_rahul.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (auto-call, reset, replay, report) work end-to-end. Run `python /app/backend/tests/reset_rahul.py` before demoing and `python /app/backend/tests/cleanup_qa_leads.py` (or the inline Mongo snippet above) after. Backend suite runs serially with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -n 0`. Parallel run has one flaky test unrelated to the new features. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env — no localhost.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — this iteration is feature verification, not a bug hunt. All four new features are implemented correctly and integrated (backend endpoint + frontend UI + persistence).
